history.summary: THIS IS A SIKH GURDWARA, NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. Gurdwara Sri Haji Rattan Sahib stands near Sabzi Mandi, about 2 km from Bathinda city centre. It is named after the Muslim saint Haji Rattan: his tomb (dargah) and an adjoining mosque stand next to the gurdwara, making this an unusual syncretic shrine visited by Sikhs, Muslims and Hindus alike. The site is associated with the visits of three Sikh Gurus — Guru Nanak Dev, Guru Hargobind and Guru Gobind Singh. According to the gurdwara's own history board, Guru Gobind Singh came here via Bhagu, met Pir Haji Ratan, and after the townspeople invited him, went on to the Qila (fort). Another account says the Guru camped for the night outside the mausoleum on his way to Talwandi Sabo; the tomb keepers warned it was haunted, but the Guru stayed to show such superstitions were unfounded. The site was declared a Sikh gurdwara under the Sikh Gurdwaras Act (Schedule I entry), and there is a sarovar where visitors take ritual baths.

name: Gurdwara Haji Rattan Sahib
town_description: Bathinda is one of the oldest cities in Punjab, known for the historic Qila Mubarak fort. It is an administrative and railway junction city in the Malwa region, with a mix of Sikh, Hindu and Muslim heritage sites. The city hosts two historic Sikh gurdwaras — Qila Mubarak Sahib and Haji Rattan Sahib — alongside old Hindu temples.
tradition: Sikhism (syncretic shrine with adjacent Muslim dargah and mosque)

travel.airport: Bathinda Airport (~25 km northwest) (verify); Chandigarh International Airport ~230 km.
travel.railway: Bathinda Junction (~2-3 km) is a major rail junction on the Delhi–Ferozepur line.
travel.road: Centrally located within Bathinda city near Sabzi Mandi; easily reached by local auto, taxi or bus.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March, when Punjab's weather is cool and pleasant; Baisakhi and Gurpurabs are peak times.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Open daily with morning and evening prayers; langar served. Exact daily timings not confirmed (verify).
